payload.entry: Changed BryanBugyi_CV, BryanBugyi_Batman_CV, BryanBugyi_Google_CV, and BryanBugyi_LangChain_CV .tex sources and PDFs. Removed gutils.tex inputs from base and Batman; base now explicitly loads enumitem, ulem[normalem], xparse, and the declarecommand alias; Batman explicitly loads enumitem. Updated the base CV with the approved SASE entry and corrected Google tense; removed stale CLI, telemetry, and plugin claims from the three older variants. Installed TinyTeX packages ebgaramond, fontawesome5, listings, ulem, and tocloft. Built all four PDFs twice with pdflatex; page counts remain base 3, Batman 2, Google 2, LangChain 2. mutool text extraction confirms Google ends May 2026 in each PDF, stale-claim scan is clear, and every page was visually reviewed against its saved baseline. Nothing left undone.

Rebuilt base, Batman, Google, and LangChain PDFs successfully; page counts remain 3/2/2/2. Verified Google ends May 2026 in every PDF, stale-claim scan is clear, both base and Batman build without gutils.tex, and visually reviewed every output page against its saved baseline.

Final reviewer decision: eval_pilot = skip. No pilot harness or real runs were produced. Phase sase-1jo.4 must carry this full deferred pilot spec: optional pilot between applying and the onsite, without delaying applications; 8-12 coding tasks from real, already-merged history, each frozen at the selected commit’s parent with that commit’s own tests as oracle in a declarative task manifest; explicit checks for passing tests, scope compliance, and required artifacts, keeping timeouts and failed runs in the denominator; record harness, model, version, and exact prompt for each run; repeat a subset and report variance, pass@k, and per-task outcomes; log runs as MLflow traces and use mlflow.genai.evaluate scorers only when clarifying results, localizing and reporting one regression from a trace; keep fakey conformance results separate from real-agent task-success scores. For any future approved implementation, put dev tooling in tools/agent_eval_pilot/ after reading tools/AGENTS.md; keep MLflow optional (e.g. uv run --with mlflow) with no runtime dependency; consider sase tool run for success-check records and triage evidence; unit tests use a stub launcher and plumbing smoke uses explicitly labeled fakey; real launches from an agent require /sase_run LaunchApproval and waiting uses /sase_monitor. The future README must give one real-pilot command and explain the outcome table and pass@k. These are deferred requirements, not completed capabilities or measured results. Authoritative references: plan:202610/databricks_followups.md and research:202610/databricks_nyc_cv_and_role_pitches/databricks_nyc_cv_and_role_pitches.md (Application plan and timeline, item 4).
Verified final eval_pilot=skip branch; full deferred pilot spec recorded for sase-1jo.4; no implementation changes or model runs; no remaining phase epic-symbol entries.
